svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.10.9.16 Separation of Residential Suites
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.10.9.16 Separation of Residential Suites
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION
Separation of Residential Suites

g.text: Boarders' rooms in the proprietor's residence,
not more than 8 boarders, no cooking:
Dwelling unit of 2 or more storeys, basements
included: 1 h fire separation from the rest
of the building (also houses with a secondary suite)
15 min: all smoke alarms photo-electric, interconnected
45 min: alarms not as in (a) or (b)
No rating: the building is sprinklered

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Suites in residential occupancies are separated from adjacent
rooms and suites by a fire separation having a fire-resistance
rating of not less than 45 min
Except as provided in Sentences (2) to (4) and Article 9.10.21.2.
Sleeping rooms in boarding and lodging houses for not more
than 8 boarders or lodgers need not be separated from the
remainder of the floor area as required in Sentence (1)
Where the sleeping rooms form part of the proprietor's residence
and do not contain cooking facilities.
Dwelling units of 2 or more storeys, including basements, and
houses with a secondary suite including their common spaces,
are separated from the remainder of the building by a fire
separation of not less than 1 h
Except as provided in Sentence (4). See Note A-3.3.4.4.(1).
In a house with a secondary suite, dwelling units are
separated from each other and from ancillary spaces and common
spaces by a fire separation
(a) of not less than 15 min when all smoke alarms in the house are
photo-electric and interconnected as in Clause 9.10.19.5.(2)(a)
(see also Sentence 9.10.3.1.(2)), (b) of not less than 30 min when
additional photo-electric smoke alarms are installed and
interconnected as in Clause 9.10.19.5.(2)(b) (see also Sentence
9.10.3.1.(3)), (c) of not less than 45 min when smoke alarms are
not installed and interconnected as in (a) or (b), or (d) with no
rating required if the building is sprinklered.
A landing level in an egress stairway from a dwelling unit is not a
storey of that dwelling unit if used only for pedestrian travel.
Drawn: plans cut low and slices, cut faces toward you. Red: fire separations. Room sizes are illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.10.9.16. (page 9-71)
